title: Artisan Sourdough Made Simple: A Beginner's Guide to Delicious Handcrafted Bread with Mini
description: The easy way to bake bread at home — all you need is FLOUR, WATER and SALT to get started! Begin your sourdough journey with the bestselling beginner's book on sourdough baking — nearly 300,000 copies sold! Many bakers speak of their sourdough starter as if it has a magical life of its own, so it can be intimidating to those new to the sourdough world; fortunately with Artisan Sourdough Made Simple , Emilie Raffa removes the fear and proves that baking with sourdough is easy, and can fit into even a working parent’s schedule! Any new baker is inevitably hit with question after question. Emilie has the answers. As a professionally trained chef and avid home baker, she uses her experience to guide readers through the science and art of sourdough. With step-by-step master recipe guides, readers learn how to create and care for their own starters, plus they get more than 60 unique recipes to bake a variety of breads that suit their every need. Featured recipes include: - Roasted Garlic and Rosemary Bread - Cinnamon Raisin Swirl - Blistered Asiago Rolls with Sweet Apples and Rosemary - Multigrain Sandwich Bread - No-Knead Tomato Basil Focaccia - Raspberry Gingersnap Twist - Sunday Morning Bagels - and so many more! With the continuing popularity of the whole foods movement, home cooks are returning to the ancient practice of bread baking, and sourdough is rising to the forefront. Through fermentation, sourdough bread is easier on digestion—often enough for people who are sensitive to gluten—and healthier. Artisan Sourdough Made Simple gives everyone the knowledge and confidence to join the fun, from their first rustic loaf to beyond. description: Tired of baking bread machine loaves that are too big to finish? Bread Machine Cookbook for Small Loaves is a practical bread machine cookbook for solo bakers, couples, empty nesters, and small households who want fresh homemade bread in realistic portions. Instead of oversized batches, this book focuses on compact loaves designed to be baked, sliced, and finished without waste. These are not simply reduced versions of standard bread recipes. Each loaf is built specifically for small-batch bread machine baking, with balanced hydration, yeast, flour, fat, and add-ins suited to smaller dough sizes. Inside, you’ll find: • Everyday white and sandwich breads for toast, lunch, and simple meals • Whole grain and rustic loaves with wheat, oats, rye-style blends, bran, seeds, and grains • High-protein bread machine recipes using Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, eggs, seeds, and vital wheat gluten • Lower-carb and alternative flour options with almond flour, oat flour, buckwheat, and blended flour formulas • Savory breads, lightly sweet breakfast loaves, and practical small-batch dough recipes • Pizza dough, rolls, buns, bagels, flatbread, focaccia, spreads, toppings, sandwich ideas, troubleshooting, and quick reference charts Includes Dough Cycle finishing directions. The Dough & Beyond section does not stop when the bread machine finishes kneading and proofing. Each dough recipe includes the next steps for shaping, rising, baking, boiling, or skillet cooking — so pizza dough, dinner rolls, burger buns, flatbreads, bagels, and focaccia can be finished with confidence. Every bread recipe includes US customary and metric measurements, bread machine loading order, recommended cycle and crust setting, dough check guidance, finished loaf size, and nutritional information per slice.
